protocol.name: stratified 5-fold cross-validation (shared with all previous tasks)
protocol.preprocessing: StandardScaler refit within each training fold for every condition. Both prior and control columns are computed per row from observable features only, using no labels and no fitted statistic.
protocol.prior_derivation: Preferred stem count 8 and consistency threshold 0.5 taken from the public design description (PROJECT_BRIEF section 7, Task 1 generator documentation). Not fitted, not tuned, no latent variable used.
protocol.generic_control_derivation: free_energy^2 and reg_feature_1 * pathway_feature_1. Chosen WITHOUT consulting any label: one square and one product of features already in the model. Comparable in mathematical form to the structural pair, so the comparison isolates provenance rather than complexity.
protocol.hyperparameter_tuning: none; prior constants come from the public design description

conditions.LR2_logistic_structural_prior: LR0 + the two structural prior columns (M2)
conditions.P2_prototype_structural_prior: P0 + the two structural prior columns (M2, main)
conditions.P2d_prototype_bounded_penalty: P0 + bounded structural penalty inside the distance (secondary control)

prior_diagnostics.note: Correlations are reported for DIAGNOSTIC interpretation of whether the prior targets the intended region. They are not used to fit, select, or tune anything.
